desc:
🏭 Welcome to 2 Player Raid Tycoon!

USE CODE 'TY12000' IN THE SHOP!!!
OP CODE AT 14,000 LIKES!!!

NEW LAB UPDATE!
Team up with a friend, build a factory, and raid everyone else's.

How to Play:
🏭 Claim a side of a factory and start production
💰 Earn cash, unlock droppers, conveyors and upgraders
🏗️ Build your factory up floor by floor
🔫 Unlock 9 weapons, from the pistol to the flamethrower and rocket launcher
🥷 Raid rival factories: shoot out their power, crack the vault, run the cash home
🛡️ Defend with walls, laser doors, turrets and guards
🎟️ Recruit guards and roll for Rare, Epic and Legendary defenders
✈️ Call airstrikes on your enemies, or take revenge on whoever got you
🏆 Events every few minutes: Air Drops, King of the Hill, Oddball and Double Cash
🎁 Daily rewards, play-time gifts and codes

🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile, Console and Tablet players

USE CODE 'LAUNCH' TO GET EARLY PERKS!
